regime: no-work END-TO-END: admission-control collectors (priority processor for bridges, memory_limiter for vanilla/no-tracing), 1 CPU / 256Mi / GOMEMLIMIT 230MiB, soft 50 / hard 70, cp_safety_factor 1, force_gc
store: Jaeger 12 cores, Elasticsearch 26 cores / 16 GiB heap, tags as object fields, 12 shards, 0 replicas, refresh 10s, async translog, merge threads 8, ES_BULK_WORKERS 24
design: 5 kinds (nt, v, pb, cgpb, sb) x 3 repetitions x 28 offered rates 500..14000, 30 s/point, 100% sampling, CPD 2-6 inverse_depth, leaf rejection
audit: 420/420 points verified, 0 HTTP/socket errors, 0 restarts, hp_refused = 0 over all 420 points
note: distinct regime from nw-100pct-n3 (passthrough collectors); do not overlay the two

kinds_per_figure.nwe2e-drop-rates: v, pb, cgpb, sb (no-tracing has no SDK, so no drop rate exists)

drop_metric_definitions.formula: spans refused / spans handled, summed over the selected collectors (one formula for every variant)
drop_metric_definitions.except_worst: the 7 collectors left after removing the one with the highest rate for that metric
drop_metric_definitions.worst: the single collector with the highest rate for that metric
drop_metric_definitions.note: nwe2e-drop-rates.* is the layout matching the real-work campaign and mixes variants: total=all, checkpoint=worst, non-checkpoint=all
